culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Masao Jinbo. Jinbo and the brown haired man whom he killed 5 years ago in the forest of suicide victims were involved in an embezzlement scam that acquired them 50 billion yen from a confectionery enterprise. They then decided to leave the money in a briefcase at an inn for safekeeping and to build its interest. The brown haired man had a feeling that his partner would kill him to keep all the money so he removed the bills to a hidden location, leaving a threatening post death message in a jar. The brief-case now containing the money was under the possession of the owner.

motive.quote: They then decided to leave the money in a briefcase at an inn for safekeeping and to build its interest.

method.quote: Few years later he discovered a suicide body and stole cigarettes, milk and recipe from it and planted it on his dead partner's body to create a false time of death, when the body would be discovered.

evidence.quote: Few years later he discovered a suicide body and stole cigarettes, milk and recipe from it and planted it on his dead partner's body to create a false time of death, when the body would be discovered.

motive.zhHans: 他们随后决定把钱装进一只公文包，留在旅馆保管，靠它生利息。那名褐发男子觉得同伙会为了独吞这笔钱而杀他，于是把纸币转移到了藏起来的地方，并在一只罐子里留下了一封带有威胁意味的「死后留言」。如今装着钱的那只公文包落在旅馆老板手里。抢劫（旧案）。地点：糕点公司。时间：五年前。金额：一亿日元。犯人：Masao Jinbo 与穿红外套的男子。Jinbo 认定，如今他唯一能拿到这笔钱的办法，就是到那家旅馆去当雇员。
motive.en: They then decided to leave the money in a briefcase at an inn for safekeeping and to build its interest. The brown haired man had a feeling that his partner would kill him to keep all the money so he removed the bills to a hidden location, leaving a threatening post death message in a jar. The brief-case now containing the money was under the possession of the owner. Robbery (past) Location: Confectionery company Time: 5 years ago Amount: 100 million Yen Culprits: Masao Jinbo and Man with the red coat Jinbo decided the only way he could obtain the money now was to employ himself as a worker at said inn.

method.zhHans: 几年后，他发现了一具自杀的尸体，从尸体上偷走香烟、牛奶和食谱，再把它们放到已死同伙的尸体上，伪造出尸体的死亡时间——那是尸体将被发现时的样子。
method.en: Few years later he discovered a suicide body and stole cigarettes, milk and recipe from it and planted it on his dead partner's body to create a false time of death, when the body would be discovered.

evidence.zhHans: 几年后，他发现了一具自杀的尸体，从尸体上偷走香烟、牛奶和食谱，再把它们放到已死同伙的尸体上，伪造出尸体的死亡时间——那是尸体将被发现时的样子。因此 Jinbo 也暴露了：他从一开始就知道小五郎才是真正的「沉睡的小五郎」。
evidence.en: Few years later he discovered a suicide body and stole cigarettes, milk and recipe from it and planted it on his dead partner's body to create a false time of death, when the body would be discovered. Hence Jinbo had revealed that he knew from the start that that Kogoro was the real Sleeping Kogoro.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Masao Jinbo。Jinbo 与那名褐发男子五年前在「自杀者之森」被杀——他们曾卷入一起侵占案，从一家糕点企业骗取了五百亿日元。他们随后决定把钱装进一只公文包，留在旅馆保管，靠它生利息。那名褐发男子觉得同伙会为了独吞这笔钱而杀他，于是把纸币转移到了藏起来的地方，并在一只罐子里留下了一封带有威胁意味的「死后留言」。如今装着钱的那只公文包落在旅馆老板手里。地点：糕点公司。时间：五年前。
